name: Permanent Residence (Visa E-1, Family of a Cuban Citizen)

requirements.blocker_text: Visa E-1 grants permanent residence to a foreigner who is the parent, child, or spouse of a Cuban citizen (with proof of the relationship and, for spouses, a legal marriage). Applying inside Cuba requires a personal request letter, form MOD AP1, four photos, passport copy, legalized birth certificate, a criminal record check (under 3 months old), medical exam results (chest X-ray, HIV, serology), notarized consent from the Cuban reference person, and proof of economic solvency; applying abroad requires a birth certificate, proof of habitual residence, a medical exam (under 6 months old), proof of technical/practical qualifications for those aged 16-60, a criminal record check, and proof of economic resources. Fees run 5,000 Cuban pesos plus 250 pesos for the ID card if applying in Cuba, or $55 USD/EUR plus 250 pesos at a Cuban consulate abroad. The immigration authority typically responds in 3-6 months. This is distinct from Visa E-2, a general, discretionary residence-authorization category for foreigners without a qualifying Cuban family relationship.
requirements.fix_path: Gather the relationship proof and required documents, pay the applicable fee, and submit through the immigration authority in Cuba or a Cuban consulate abroad; expect a 3-6 month response.

evidence_required.document: Notarized consent from the Cuban reference person (if applying in Cuba)
